enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Superior Disruption: On Hit: 4 to 24 Bane damage to Undead.On Vorpal Hit: If an undead struck by this weapon has fewer than 2500 Hit Points, it is instantly slain. If the undead has above 2500 Hit Points, it takes 250 damage.
Bludgeoning 6: The edges of this weapon are blunted, dealing an additional 6d6 bludgeon damage on each hit.

Corrosive Salt: This weapon stores a caustic, insatiable power deep within. When this weapon is used, this power can come to the surface in the form of a noxious, corrosive salt that dissolves all substances.
Undead Bane 6: Those that have died must return, and this weapon is attuned specifically to lay them to rest. This weapon deals an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Undead.
